svg.title: Graphical Abstract — Synthesis of Graphene
svg.desc: Graphite oxidation to GO, then reduction to graphene (chemical route)
svg.text: Graphite → graphene oxide → reduced graphene · Hummers-style route

g.text: ① Intercalation & oxidation (Hummers) opens the graphite gallery
② Sonication / stirring yields hydrophilic GO sheets with O-functional groups
③ Chemical or thermal reduction restores conjugated sp² network → graphene / rGO
